# Pendo Orchestrate

Skills that teach agents to work with Pendo Orchestrate. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [pendo-io/claude-pendo-plugin](https://github.com/pendo-io/claude-pendo-plugin), at commit `a0f8526`.

Create, configure, and edit draft Orchestrate email journeys via Pendo MCP — multi-email journeys and conditional split flows.

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **Pendo Orchestrate**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **Pendo Orchestrate**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install pendo-orchestrate@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

1 skills: `orchestrate-journeys`.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

It ships no scripts. The skills are guidance for the agent.
